acts.palette: Ice blue, chalk white, canal green, weathered brass, charcoal, swarm teal.
acts.map: Tall vertical overhead papercraft diorama of a fictional canal ice warehouse, read bottom to top: green towpath and forked brass gates at the bottom, a basin with little brown boats and a forked iron ice track, then stacked ice blocks and cargo along the sides, ending at a circular frozen well at the top where the Ice-Well Admiral waits. Leave a broad, uncluttered middle corridor of pale water for path lines. Teal hexagons creep from the well along the banks. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at mechanical joints; shadow-theatre lighting. No labels, logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background inside a cold canal loading basin: pale blue water, muted green towpath, distant brown boat hulls, iron rails and stacked white ice blocks placed around the edges; a few small teal hexagonal growths appear on a far wall. Keep the center open and free of any subject. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background deeper in the ice warehouse: muted blue ice stacks, quiet cargo shelves, green water and faint rail lines recede to the sides; teal hexagonal growth spreads across the lower walls and around the cargo. Keep the center open and free of any subject. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background near the frozen well: dim blue ice, partially buried hulls and rails frame the edges while dense teal hexagonal growth blankets much of the walls and encroaches on the floor. Keep a quiet, open center for combat. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.
acts.boss: Ice-Well Admiral, full body and centered: a massive circular gray stone well mounted on broad charcoal caterpillar tracks, its thick rim capped with jagged ice-blue paper and ringed by tiny brass tug cranes with pinned joints. Show the entire tracked silhouette, cranes reaching outward and intact boat fittings visible in the dark well. Sparse teal hexagons cling to the stone. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at mechanical joints; shadow-theatre lighting. No labels, logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background at a working waterfront: muted blue water, brown timber quay, varied boat hulls and cream sail shapes arranged at the edges, with a few teal hexagons on a distant piling. Keep the center open and free of any subject. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background in a boat repair yard: subdued brown workshop walls, brass measuring frames, rope coils and blue hull plates flank a quiet central dock; teal hexagonal growth spreads over the frames and along the quay. Keep the center open and free of any subject. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.

acts.boss: Grand Registrar, full body and centered: a huge floating black dock with an unmistakable broad rectangular silhouette, enormous open brass calipers arching out to either side, blue hull plates fixed to its central frame and clusters of small articulated crane arms rising above. Brass pins mark every hinge; small teal hexagonal patches spread over the dock. Show the whole machine against a simple pale harbor field. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.

acts.palette: Deep harbor blue, parchment cream, ocher, dark green, aged brass, swarm teal.

Leave a broad open middle waterway for readable path lines. Teal hexagonal growth advances toward the basin. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at mechanical joints; shadow-theatre lighting. No labels, compass lettering, logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background at the port approaches: muted blue water, ocher quay edges, cream cut-paper chart shores and distant boat silhouettes flank the scene; a few teal hexagons cling to one slipway. Keep the center open and free of any subject. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background among port workshops and altered charts: pale overlapping shoreline shapes, dark green cabinets, raised ship-model ribs and ocher arches sit to the sides; teal hexagonal growth spreads across walls, charts and mooring edges. Keep the center open and free of any subject. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background inside the sealed harbor: subdued blue basin, closed ocher harbor walls and ranks of bound boat silhouettes line the edges; dense teal hexagonal growth consumes the walls and spills across much of the water. acts.boss: Horizon Engine, full body and centered: a vast aged-brass compass ring mounted above a deep blue harbor basin, its unlettered pointer aimed in one direction. Large white triangular sail vanes radiate from the ring, and many small jointed boat cranes surround the basin. Show the complete wide silhouette, with tiny blue tenders nested within and teal hexagonal growth along the base. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting; no text or logos.
